dispositions.rationale: Correct. Checked against the repo snapshot of AB 747: CCP 417.10(a)(1) requires photos for service under 415.10, 415.20 and 415.45 (personal, substituted, posting), not only alternative service; 415.45 posting needs a court order; prior CCP 1166(a)(5) already required the method of notice service, and the new version adds date, time and location; the no-signal, safety and door/entrance exceptions apply.
dispositions.change_applied: Quick Answer, Key Facts row, Section 1 short answer and bullets (court-authorized posting; personal service; door/entrance and no-signal/safety exceptions; complaint 'already had to state how'), Before/After table, FAQ 5 and Video Script paragraph 2 rewritten. Video page: Key Takeaways 1-2, chapter label and the same script paragraph.
dispositions.quote_before: eviction papers need three real delivery attempts and GPS-stamped photo proof of service
dispositions.quote_after: before substituted service or court-authorized posting of eviction papers, the process server must try personal delivery three times, on three different days at three different times, and proofs of service generally need a date-, time- and location-stamped photo

dispositions.rationale: Correct. Civ. 1940.11(b)(2)(B): the original isn't required for images not created with a capture device; fully AI-generated images still need the disclosure; routine edits are excluded only when they don't change the representation.
dispositions.change_applied: Quick Answer, Key Facts row, Section 2 short answer, Before/After row, FAQ 3 and Video Script paragraph 3 now say 'if the image started as a photo' and keep the representation condition. Video page Key Takeaway 3 and script paragraph 3 match.
dispositions.quote_before: a rental ad with a virtually staged or otherwise altered photo must say so and show the original
dispositions.quote_after: a rental ad with a digitally altered or AI-generated image must disclose it on or next to the image and, if the image started as a photo, include or link to the original

dispositions.rationale: Correct. Pen. Code 396(e)(2) has two defenses, (A) a pre-declaration contractual increase and (B) qualifying repairs or additions with rental status or documented intent; the 10% is measured against the (j)(11) rental price, not simply 'an increase'.
dispositions.change_applied: Key Facts row, Section 3 short answer and intro (statutory baseline), the defenses bullet (both defenses with the rental-status/intent condition), Before/After row, FAQ 4 and Video Script paragraph 4. Video page Key Takeaway 4 and script paragraph 4 match.
dispositions.quote_before: During a declared emergency, rent increases over ten percent are price gouging.
dispositions.quote_after: During a declared emergency, California's price-gouging law generally bars rent more than ten percent above a pre-emergency baseline, with limited defenses the owner has to prove.

dispositions.rationale: Correct. Civ. 1942.7.5(b)(1) requires access on the property website and in fully controlled digital ads; third-party sites and search engines only where they permit or support it.
dispositions.change_applied: Quick Answer, Key Facts row, Section 4 short answer and access bullet, Before/After row, self-managed table row, checklist, FAQ 1, FAQ 2, excerpt and Video Script paragraph 5. Video page Key Takeaway 5 and script paragraph 5 match.
dispositions.quote_before: linked in online listings and handed out with every application
dispositions.quote_after: available on the property website and in digital ads they control (and on third-party sites where the platform allows it), and given with every application

dispositions.rationale: Correct. Prior CCP 1166(a)(5) already required the method; AB 747's new version adds date, time and location.
dispositions.change_applied: Before/After table row and Section 1 complaint bullet; FAQ 5 updated to match.
dispositions.quote_before: No requirement to state when, where and how the notice was served
dispositions.quote_after: Through 2026: Must state how the termination notice was served. From 2027: Must also state the date, time and location of service.

dispositions.rationale: Correct. 396(m) and 396(f) are separate rules; the draft could be read as an above-cap re-rental carveout.
dispositions.change_applied: Evict-and-re-rent bullet replaced with the reviewer's wording, lightly edited.
dispositions.quote_before: A lawful eviction for another reason, or one that began before the declaration, can continue.
dispositions.quote_after: The law still allows evictions for lawful reasons. Separately, it bars evicting a tenant during the protected period and then renting or offering the unit for more than the evicted tenant could have been charged. An eviction lawfully begun before the declaration may continue.
